D: A young man finds out the men in his family can travel back in time and uses it to find love and make the most of life.
P: Serve the main when Tim and Mary meet at the dinner in the dark.
S: Cornish beach crab and cress sandwiches
Lemon crab mayo and cress on buttered soft white bread

Soft white bread with lemony crab mayonnaise, fresh cress and cucumber, crusts off and cut into fingers for a windy Cornish beach. Mix 250g crab meat with 3 tbsp mayonnaise, the zest and juice of half a lemon, a pinch of cayenne and salt. Butter 8 slices of soft white bread. Spread the crab over 4 slices, add thin cucumber slices and a handful of cress, then close. Press gently, trim the crusts and cut each sandwich into 3 fingers.
Shortcrust pasties of beef, potato, swede and onion, brown sauce

Little crimped pasties of diced beef, potato, swede and onion with plenty of pepper, baked golden and served with brown sauce. Mix 300g finely diced rump, 1 small diced potato, 100g finely diced swede, 1 diced onion, 1 tsp salt and 1 tsp cracked pepper. Cut 8 rounds from 4 sheets shortcrust pastry. Spoon filling onto one half of each, add a small knob of butter, fold over and crimp the edge. Brush with beaten egg, cut a small slit and bake at 190C for 35 minutes until golden. Serve with brown sauce.
M: Red wine braised lamb shanks over buttery mashed potato

Lamb shanks braised in red wine, rosemary and tomato until falling off the bone, over buttery mash, a dish you could eat with your eyes shut. Brown 4 lamb shanks in 2 tbsp oil. Add 1 diced onion, 2 carrots, 2 celery sticks and 3 garlic cloves and cook 5 minutes. Add 250ml red wine, 400g tin crushed tomatoes, 500ml beef stock, 2 rosemary sprigs and 2 bay leaves. Cover and braise at 160C for 2 hours 30 minutes. Boil 1kg potatoes and mash with 60g butter and 100ml milk. Reduce the sauce and spoon over.
W: Strawberries, passionfruit, whipped cream and crushed meringue

Crushed meringue, strawberries and passionfruit folded through vanilla whipped cream, an English dessert that is meant to look a mess. Slice 400g strawberries and toss with 1 tbsp caster sugar and the pulp of 2 passionfruit. Leave 15 minutes. Whip 300ml thickened cream with 1 tsp vanilla to soft peaks. Roughly break 6 meringue nests. Gently fold the meringue, most of the strawberries and their juices through the cream so it streaks. Spoon into 4 glasses and top with the rest of the berries.
K: Dad's ping pong Earl Grey iced tea
Earl Grey with honey and lemon, topped with soda water over ice

Earl Grey brewed strong with honey, chilled and poured over ice with lemon and a splash of soda for a bit of fizz. Steep 5 Earl Grey tea bags in 800ml boiling water with 3 tbsp honey for 5 minutes. Remove the bags, cool, then chill for 1 hour. Fill 4 tall glasses with ice and lemon slices. Pour in the tea to three-quarters full and top each with a splash of soda water. Garnish with a lemon wheel.
